# Review a social-network pull request

Compare the diff with the [active ticket](../../docs/social-network/ticket-tracker.md) and its [track A](../../docs/social-network/track-a.md) or [track B](../../docs/social-network/track-b.md) definition. Check the [Zone01 requirements](../../docs/social-network/requirements.md) and applicable approved decisions. Verify scope, dependencies, evidence for the stated gate, changed links, and any remaining unverified steps. Report findings with file and line references. Treat the imported forum audit as historical material.
